title: Night time at Mall World
content: https://preview.redd.it/wpxn5jfx10yd1.jpg?width=1792&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=82bac2f937a81002860001f491ed7f52622d875a The first time I visited Mall World was in 2021. I had started drinking Egyptian blue lotus tea to help me sleep after a particularly stressful time in my life. At this time, I had a series of incredible dreams. The one that stands out the most is when I visited the casino. This is the first time trying to recreate this dreamscape, and it isn't 100%, but it's close enough for now. I remember this HUGE, twinkling, stunning tree right by the water's edge and amongst the chaos of a neon-lit city. The sight took my breath away, and it was so impactful that I almost realised I was dreaming, but I didn't transition to lucid dreaming because this place also felt real and familiar. Earlier in the dream, I was leaving the casino where I met a family who I understood were my family from a past life. I linked arms with one of the girls, and we excitedly skipped together, catching up on our past and current lives. We found ourselves lost in a very classy area with beautiful apartments with archways. I haven't been back to Mall World for years now, and I miss it.
